subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2) i.e. 'among'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Among"** is used to indicate that something is in a group or surrounded by other things or people, which fits the context of students.
 
• The phrase **"fear of math among students"** is a common and natural collocation used in educational discussions.
 
• **"Among"** appropriately conveys that this issue is widespread within the group of students, as highlighted in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'among'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"of"** would not fit because it does not convey the idea of being in a group.
 
• **"on"** is incorrect as it does not fit grammatically in this context.
 
• **"between"** would be incorrect because it implies a choice or something that involves two distinct entities, which is not the case here
